0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the 76ers, who are 1-0 after a road win and sit 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East. Cleveland has no tallies yet, and Nae'Qwan Tomlin is out with a back issue, while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. For Philadelphia, Ariel Hukporti is out with a ruptured Achilles, Dominick Barlow is out with a back issue, Tacko Fall is out with a hip injury, and Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. Cleveland won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 115-101 in Cleveland on March 9, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
